reason: Monthly daytime carbon monoxide mixing ratio at 500 hPa, not surface air quality. This broad gridded pollution product replaces the sparse OCO-2 carbon-dioxide tracks; CO and CO₂ are different gases.
Surface-layer soil moisture from a satellite-constrained land model. Ocean pixels are outside the product’s land domain.
Monthly modeled surface reflectivity: the fraction of incoming sunlight reflected by the surface. This is not surface roughness.
Modeled upper-layer soil temperature from the SMAP land model, not atmospheric temperature or land subsidence.
Satellite-constrained modeled moisture deeper in the soil, where plant roots draw water. This is a land-water measurement, not tectonic motion.
Monthly water stored in seasonal snow, expressed as the depth of melted water. The retrieval has land, snow and regional limitations; it is not glacier or sea-ice thickness.
Morning land-surface freeze/thaw classification. It is categorical, not ice-sheet elevation; unmapped areas are outside the valid retrieval domain.
Modeled carbon uptake by photosynthesis. This measures vegetation activity, not the percentage of ground covered by vegetation.
Sea surface temperature departure from the product’s climatology. Positive values indicate warmer water than its reference, not greater wave height.
